clauses.quote: The Santa Ana Education Association (SAEA) and the Santa Ana Unified School District (SAUSD) shall through a committee comprised of four (4) members appointed by SAEA and four (4) members appointed by SAUSD: Develop new teacher training and support programs pursuant to Education Code section 44506(c)(5). (Assembly Bill No 1x, First Extraordinary Session, 1999) Develop professional development for all teachers pursuant to Education Code section 44506(c)(4). (Assembly Bill No. IX, First Extraordinary Session, 1999)
clauses.subject_text: The Santa Ana Education Association (SAEA) and the Santa Ana Unified School District (SAUSD)
clauses.notes: Joint obligation spanning numbered subsections to develop PD programs.

clauses.quote: The SAEA and the District shall also jointly develop a budget annually utilizing the AB IX funding not budgeted for the Peer Assistance and Review Program, to develop and implement new teacher training and support programs and staff development for all teachers.
Such programs and budget shall be recommended to the Governing Board for consideration and adoption pursuant to its annual budgeting process.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the joint committee.

clauses.quote: SAEA appointees shall receive $200 for each meeting attended.
Meetings shall occur outside the normal duty day.
clauses.notes: Scheduling condition tied to stipend eligibility.

clauses.quote: The parties agree to evaluate this process and pay arrangement on an annual basis and make adjustments accordingly, to meet the needs of the PAR program and joint committee members.
clauses.notes: Procedural agreement to review program and stipends.

clauses.quote: The Consulting teacher's role shall not replace or in any way erode the responsibility of the principal or assistant principal as evaluators as described in the Stull Act.
clauses.notes: Restriction on peer PAR role protects management's statutory evaluation authority.

clauses.quote: The statute does not permit the Consulting Teacher or the PAR Panel to evaluate the Participating Teacher.
clauses.notes: Statutory limitation reinforcing management's exclusive evaluation rights.
